objective: Implement Phase A of the Coding Continuity Supervisor (schema, RPCs, checkpoint validator, state machine, tests) without applying the migration to production.
diff_summary: Phase A: additive migration (6 coding_* tables, 8 RPCs, RLS service-role only, 7 seeded workers), DB scenario, checkpoint validator, state machine, tests, regenerated fingerprint (+161 lines, none changed). last_commit is the Phase A code commit; the handover-docs commit that carries this file sits on top of it.
tests_run: node --test (includes schema replay and the coding_continuity scenario)
decisions: New tables use the coding_ prefix (coding_checkpoints, coding_handoffs) because the applied 2026-09-22 POC owns continuity_checkpoints/continuity_handoffs.
A FROZEN lease blocks its branch until reclaim_coding_lease marks it RECLAIMED (added RPC).
RPCs use security invoker + empty search_path, matching the existing coding agent RPCs.
COMPLETED is a terminal state reachable only from CHECKPOINTING after completion gates.
Phase B skipped by Claude to protect the handover.
constraints: Do not merge PR #102 or apply the migration without Fahad's approval.
Do not touch core routing, capacity, FINANCE/AUDIT/fact gate, V5 UI, POC continuity_* tables, Hermes.
errors: First replay failed: continuity_checkpoints already existed (POC); fixed by renaming the new tables.
